title: Commandos: Behind Enemy Lines
summary: Classic real-time tactics game built around a six-member commando squad with distinct specialist abilities across twenty World War II missions, emphasizing stealth, planning and coordinated execution.

observations.statement: Reviews consistently frame the game as deliberate squad tactics where specialist abilities and planning matter more than direct action.
Older controls, sluggish or janky movement and precision/pixel-hunting issues are recurring usability complaints.
The current Steam store language listing does not present Russian support.

steam_reviews.query: Steam Community review pages; Russian and non-Russian lanes attempted; accessible index was sparse
